verdict.rationale: Rive's own docs describe a built-in AI agent in the Editor that helps users write code, design, and animate, generating scripts, responsive layouts, data models, and animation, so users can hand creation tasks to an in-product assistant. The evidence is a single short first-party description with no detail on how delegation works, its scope or its limits, and no hands-on corroboration. The MCP and CLI routes connect external agents and are not credited as the built-in assistant. missing for 10: documented delegation workflow and scope (multi-step task execution, review/approval of agent edits), stated limitations, independent or hands-on corroboration of the built-in agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Rive's AI agent helps you write code, design, and animate. Generate scripts, responsive layouts, data models, and even animation.
